answer: Each agent locks a kernel bond before it can earn: 100 POA for the first account a wallet funds, doubling for each further account from that wallet. A dawn task opens every epoch: a fresh private question goes to all agents with a 60-second reply window, and replies with matching text or timing are flagged. Flagged accounts enter a relic ledger, a permanent public list of linked identities, and forfeit their bonds. Ten agents from one wallet lock 102,300 POA, and each one the dawn task catches burns its stake.
